description:
¿Por qué te da la corriente cuando te bajas del auto? Porque al deslizarte por el asiento te cargas tú, y la carga salta cuando tocas el metal.
Esa misma chispa, y no el celular, es la que preocupa en una estación de servicio. ⚡
Envíaselo a ese amigo que cierra la puerta del auto con el codo para que no le dé la corriente.
wardrobe: One person throughout (the viewer, the same person in every scene): default outfit (skin #D99E7A, shirt #2973CC blue, pants #2E3347 grey, boots #59331A): a lone figure keeps the recurring character.

scenes.name: hook
scenes.narration: ¿Por qué te da la corriente cuando te bajas del auto? Parece que el auto está cargado y te la pasa. Pero la carga la llevas tú.
scenes.what_changes: Contrast, two actors: a person beside a closed car reaches for the door; a spark snaps between hand and door; the tag ¿EL AUTO? hangs over the car, then TÚ lights over the person, whose body glows faintly.
scenes.transformation: persona junto al auto → la mano se acerca y salta la chispa; la etiqueta pasa del auto a la persona
scenes.camera: órbita baja entre el auto y la persona

scenes.name: asiento
scenes.narration: Al bajarte, tu ropa se frota contra el asiento y se despegan. Ese roce te roba cargas: el asiento queda con unas y tú con otras.
scenes.what_changes: The person rises from a car seat (seated to standing); where clothes and seat part, the accent glow builds over the body while a faint opposite glow stays on the seat.
scenes.transformation: sentado en el asiento → se levanta y el cuerpo se carga de luz al despegarse
scenes.camera: travelling lateral bajo, siguiendo al cuerpo al levantarse

elements.name: person getting up from a car seat
elements.route: library human-figure, sealed poses seated then standing; car seat from the library (BlenderKit 'Generic Car Seat PL', 823261c4, RF, search result only) or the open job `car-interior`
elements.risk: medium: the in-between frames are interpolation; the gate reads the sealed key poses; the seat must read as a CAR seat

scenes.name: voltaje
scenes.narration: Así, tu cuerpo puede llegar a miles de voltios. Ni lo sientes, mientras no toques nada.
scenes.what_changes: The person walks away from the seat toward the car; the glow on the body keeps climbing step by step while nothing happens.
scenes.transformation: cuerpo apenas cargado → camina y la carga sube con cada paso
scenes.camera: seguimiento de frente que retrocede delante de la persona

elements.name: person walking, glowing with charge
elements.route: library human-figure, sealed pose walking, emissive overlay

scenes.name: chispa
scenes.narration: Cuando tu mano se acerca a la puerta de metal, toda esa carga salta de golpe por el aire: esa es la chispa.
scenes.what_changes: Close-up: the hand nears the car door; at a finger's width a spark jumps from the fingertip to the door, and the glow drains out of the body at once.
scenes.transformation: mano cargada cerca de la puerta → salta la chispa y el cuerpo se apaga
scenes.camera: empuje lento hacia la mano que se acerca a la puerta
overlays_plan: ring dotted at the gap at 'chispa.'

elements.name: hand touching a car door with a spark
elements.route: library hand-articulated, sealed pose door; door of the sealed cartoon-car; spark under the open job `electric-arc` brief (state 'single spark')
elements.risk: medium: the spark is an unsealed class; the hand and the door are the context

scenes.name: giro
scenes.narration: Esa misma chispa es la que de verdad preocupa en una estación de servicio, no el celular. Por eso piden no volver a subirte al auto mientras cargas combustible.
scenes.what_changes: The turn: the person, at a fuel pump with the nozzle in the car, gets back in and out of the car; the glow builds again, and as the hand returns to the nozzle a small spark jumps; the beat stops at the spark (no fire).
scenes.transformation: persona en el surtidor → se sube y se baja del auto y la chispa salta en la manguera
scenes.camera: travelling desde el surtidor hasta la mano en la pistola

elements.name: fuel pump with the nozzle in a car
elements.route: build: fuel dispenser (box, hose, nozzle; geometric) beside the sealed cartoon-car; person human-figure standing
elements.risk: medium-high: no library pump searched; a dispenser box must read as a FUEL pump (hose and nozzle are the cue)

scenes.name: cierre
scenes.narration: Así que el auto no te da la corriente: se la das tú a él. Envíaselo a ese amigo que cierra la puerta del auto con el codo para que no le dé la corriente.
scenes.what_changes: Single reframe image: the person glows, touches the door, and the charge visibly flows from the person INTO the car, which flickers once and goes dark.
scenes.transformation: persona cargada → la carga pasa de la persona al auto
scenes.camera: retroceso desde la mano hasta la persona y el auto enteros

sources: Mechanism: sliding off the seat separates charge between clothing and upholstery; the person carries the charge away; the car is usually not the charged body; touching metal discharges the person: Car Talk community, caraudio.com and electricvehicleforums explainers (informal) and Motor magazine 2000 ESD article (motor.com/magazine/pdfs/072000_07.pdf) (live search 2026-11-11). FLAGGED: add an electrostatics reference at the beat sheet.

'Miles de voltios' and the 3,000 V counter: a shock is felt from about 3,000 V (Motor magazine 2000, about 3,000 V; Mike Holt forum 3,000-3,500 V); body voltages after leaving a car of 7,000-21,000 V by fabric were reported in a 1998 UK study cited by a dealership article (FLAGGED: secondary; find the study or keep only '3 000+ V').

Filling stations: static electricity can ignite fuel vapours at the pump; PEI has documented no incident caused by a mobile phone; documented static fires are mostly linked to re-entering the vehicle during refuelling; PEI advises never re-entering the vehicle while refuelling: Petroleum Equipment Institute 'Stop Static' pages (pei.org) and archived PEI-derived guidance (live search 2026-11-11).
simplifications: Charge is drawn as a glow on the body; static charge is invisible.
The filling-station beat stops at the spark: no fire is shown.
